verdict.rationale: ClickHouse has some background automation primitives: incremental materialized views transform data automatically at insert time, and ClickPipes, which can be managed via the CLI, provide continuously running managed ingestion from S3, Kafka, Postgres and other sources. The AI agent that queries data on a user's behalf (AI notebooks) is waitlist-only and interactive, not autonomous background work. missing for 10: scheduled or triggered autonomous jobs or agents, documentation framing these features as user-configurable background automations, AI-driven automation that runs unattended, independent or hands-on corroboration
